summary: The plan owes one implementation phase, and P1 delivered it. GitSyncDeploy 4489edc sets gitblit-app's JAVA_OPTS to "-Xmx1024M -XX:+DisableExplicitGC", which keeps the image's 1024M heap, and removes only the cpu request (memory: 4096Mi stays), as the settled fix and Ruling D2 require. The review signed off with no findings, and it confirmed that Argo's client-side apply will drop the live request. V01–V04 (the push under Ruling D1, Argo Synced/Healthy, the live JVM cmdline, no CPU request in prd, and the one-hour near-idle reading) are live checks. The plan's ordering constraints assign them to the test phase, and that phase pushes per slice-testing-strategy §4. The luceneFrequency contingency is a test-phase decision too, so no implementation phase is outstanding and nothing new goes in the close-out report.
